description: Formal Chinese imperial court portrait of the Hongwu Emperor, elderly bearded Ming founder in yellow imperial robe seated on throne, Ming dynasty portrait style.
Medieval battle scene 1415: English longbowmen loosing arrows across a muddy field toward French knights, banners, overcast sky, manuscript-illumination meets realistic painting.
Portrait of King Edward III of England, long-faced bearded Plantagenet king in royal robes with crown, medieval panel style.
Joan of Arc in shining armour carrying a white banner, entering the gates of Orléans in 1429 to cheering crowds.
Stylised antique map of the Golden Horde khanate across the Eurasian steppe from the Carpathians to Siberia, parchment style with the Volga river and Sarai marked.
The Imam Husayn Shrine in Karbala, Iraq: golden dome and twin minarets at dusk with pilgrims in the courtyard, photograph-like.
The Alhambra palace in Granada: the Court of the Lions with fountain, intricate Nasrid arches and tilework, warm afternoon light, photograph-like.
Scholars in turbans and robes studying manuscripts and astrolabes in a great Abbasid library in Baghdad, arched alcoves stacked with books, medieval illustration style.
Elegant Islamic calligraphy of the name Ali in gold thuluth script on a deep green background, decorative medallion style.
Portrait of the Persian physician-philosopher Ibn Sina (Avicenna) in turban and robes, writing at a desk with medical manuscripts and an astrolabe, miniature painting style.
Bronze statue of the Viking explorer Leif Erikson in helmet and cloak holding a shield, against a dramatic sky in Reykjavík, photograph-like.
Timur's army with war elephants defeating Ottoman forces on a dusty Anatolian plain in 1402, Persian miniature style.
Portrait of Richard III of England, pale king with dark shoulder-length hair and a slight hunch, holding a ring, late medieval panel painting style.
Rolling green Leicestershire battlefield landscape at dawn with mist, a hill and marsh, photograph-like, no people.
Tudor portrait of Anne Boleyn in a French hood and dark gown with a pearl necklace bearing the letter B pendant.
Portrait of Mary, Queen of Scots, in black mourning dress with white veil cap and crucifix, 16th-century court painting style.
The Qutb Minar in Delhi: tall tapering red sandstone minaret with balconies against a clear blue sky, photograph-like.
Naqsh-e Jahan Square in Isfahan at golden hour: vast plaza, Shah Mosque with turquoise dome and minarets, arcades, photograph-like.
Ottoman Janissaries firing muskets from behind chained wagons and cannon against charging Safavid cavalry, 1514, Persian miniature style.
A leaf of the 1375 Catalan Atlas: colourful medieval world map on vellum with wind rose, kings, caravans, ships and sea creatures, parchment texture.
